name: The Codices of Planetary Service
source: Series preface printed in The Harmonic Being Called Earth (the-harmonic-being-called-earth.md L9–54) and The Codex of Nonlocal Memory (L18–63); registries: Earth "Codex One of Six" (L787), InterBeing Lattice "Codex II of VI" (L316), Field Effect "Codex Three of Six" (L679), Nonlocal Memory "Codex Four of Six" (L698), Co-Creation Spiral "Codex Five of Six" (L515)
review_notes: James, 15 Oct 2026: keep this six-part sequence separate from the three-part corridor. Nonlocal Memory is fourth per the preface, although its registry names "The Harmonic Principles of the Field". Position 6 is the expanded edition of Trans-Species Resonance. The shorter text is its earlier edition.

name: The Codices of Planetary Service: Trilogy
source: The Codex of Coherence and Dissolution registry: "The Codices of Planetary Service (Part II of III)", companions Harmonic Architectures (Part I) and Agency of One (Part III) (L600–606); The Codex of the Agency of One registry "(III of III)" (L679) and afterword naming all three (L702–705)
review_notes: James, 15 Oct 2026: keep this three-part sequence separate from the six-part corridor. "Trilogy" is an editorial label; his text uses "The Codices of Planetary Service" for both and gives this one no distinct title. Vol. II of The Agency of One is Part III here. The Agency of One (Vol. I) is not a member.

name: The Architecture of Love
source: Member registries, e.g. codex-01-the-architecture-of-love.md L125 ("Codex Series: The Architecture of Love", "Entry Point of Series"); positions from the 01–10 titles
review_notes: James, 15 Oct 2026: keep the ten numbered works in order. Codex: The Four Frequencies of Love names the series without a position and is a related work, not a member. Registries of Codex of the Realized Flame (Part I, L678) and The Codex of Living Harmonics (L577) also name this series; those works stay in Realized Flame and Harmonic Activation, and the registry statements are kept on the entries.

name: InterBeing Glossary Series

name: Realized Flame
source: Catalog grouping by title (Codex of the Realized Flame Part I / The Codex of the Realized Flame Part II)
review_notes: Part I and Part II are a numbered sequence the titles support. No series name appears in James' text. "Realized Flame" is an editorial label, the same kind of label he accepted for the Planetary Service trilogy on 15 Oct 2026. Part I's registry names "The Architecture of Love" (L678); that statement is kept on the entry, and the work stays here.
